column1: # The Phyre PPostEffectBase class family, from MSVC RTTI (FABLE, 2026-09-21).
# Generated by gen_posteffect_family.py from the shipping EXE; do not hand-edit.
# vtable/class/bases/slots are decoded from the complete-object locator that precedes each
# vtable. render_slot is slot 6 - the per-effect render entry - and render_workers are the
# 0065xxxx bodies that override calls, read from a raw E8/E9 index rather than a call graph.
# inherits_render = the class does not override slot 6 and runs the base implementation.
# 37 classes; 9 override the render slot, 27 inherit 0065B8F0
